title: Reconnect-backoff test does not isolate the reset at confirmed recovery, nor the deadline inheritance
outcome: Reconnect-backoff test does not isolate the reset at confirmed recovery, nor the deadline inheritance
acceptance: The reconnect-backoff tests fail when the backoff reset at confirmed recovery is removed (independently of the onerror-after-open reset), and fail when the inherited fallback deadline is not resumed after an EventSource recreation that lands before that deadline.
